subject: math

objective.text: Round two- and three-digit numbers to the nearest ten using a vertical number line.

explanations.title: Count all the tens
explanations.text: 117 has 11 tens. 100 is 10 tens, and 17 has 1 more ten.

explanations.title: Endpoints for a three-digit number
explanations.text: For 117, the endpoints are 110 (11 tens) and 120 (12 tens). Halfway is 115.

explanations.title: Same picture, 100 apart
explanations.text: Rounding 17 and 117 looks the same. Every number on the line is just 1 hundred more.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 2 (corresponding points are 1 hundred milliliters apart)

explanations.title: Say it in unit form
explanations.text: 2 tens 8 ones rounded to the nearest ten is 3 tens.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 1 (S: 2 tens 8 ones rounded... is 3 tens.)

examples.title: Round 28
examples.text: Endpoints 20 and 30. Halfway is 25. 28 is more than 25, so 28 rounds to 30.

examples.title: Round 117
examples.text: Endpoints 110 and 120. Halfway is 115. 117 is more than 115, so 117 rounds to 120.

questions.text: What number is halfway between 830 and 840?

questions.text: The ballet recital begins at 12:17 p.m. and ends at 12:45 p.m. How many minutes long is it?

Round 117 milliliters to the nearest ten.
Round 175 milliliters to the nearest ten.
Round 103 kilograms to the nearest ten.
Round 142 grams to the nearest ten.

Bobby rounds 603 to the nearest ten. He says 610. Is he correct? Why?
One seed packet weighs 28 grams. Round the weight of 2 packets to the nearest 10 grams.
